scope: targeted recovery audit for direct or near-direct functional evidence in the highest-information focal taxa; absence means not recovered in this search, not proof that no study exists

phyllary_JPN36.frozen_state: appressed phyllary posture; nonsticky or nearly nonsticky involucre
phyllary_JPN36.focal_history_role: JPN36 appressed state is a current high-information phyllary transition target; current UFBoot forced fraction 0.728

recovered_pollinator_evidence.source: Effectiveness of interval photography cameras for a survey of pollinator communities: Comparison with direct observation, Applications in Plant Sciences, 2025
recovered_pollinator_evidence.interpretation: legitimate floral visitation occurs in the natural appressed-phyllary state; an open/spreading phyllary posture is therefore not a demonstrated prerequisite for pollinator access
recovered_pollinator_evidence.boundary: visitor occurrence does not quantify effective pollen transfer, compare alternate phyllary postures, or test phyllary manipulation

older_pollination_context.result: Cirsium sieboldii was among long-tubed flowers mainly visited by butterflies or small bees in the survey and discussed in relation to long-tongued Bombus diversus pollination
older_pollination_context.interpretation: independent evidence that the appressed target remains accessible to multiple legitimate visitor guilds
older_pollination_context.boundary: historical observational guild inference; not a posture-effect experiment

stickiness_JPN06_JPN15.history_role: 100/100 ML sister contrast; JPN06 current UFBoot forced fraction 0.995

authority_context.JPN06: C. dipsacolepis inhabits dry grasslands and has hard spreading to recurved phyllaries
authority_context.JPN15: C. lineare has a well-sticky involucre

stickiness_JPN06_JPN15.targeted_search_result: No focal experimental study was recovered that directly manipulates or links JPN06/JPN15 involucre stickiness to antagonist damage, pollinator effective transfer or seed fitness.

model_update.required_discriminator: within-JPN15 stickiness neutralization versus sham with local arthropod-guild, pollinator-transfer and viable-seed endpoints; JPN06 restoration only as a secondary sufficiency test

stickiness_JPN06_JPN15.boundary: failure to recover a focal publication in a targeted web search is not evidence of no ecological effect

orientation_focal_context.note: No new focal species search was needed to select the leading orientation domain because the current East-Asian transition-regime test already supplies focal ecological evidence; external Asteraceae manipulation is used only for mechanism discrimination.
orientation_focal_context.origin_boundary: current regime is not supported as the sole calendarized origin regime

chapter2_implication: Focal-species recovery does not overturn the v2 trait-specific filter model. It further weakens phyllary pollinator-access as a necessary explanation because the appressed JPN36 target is naturally visited by multiple pollinator guilds, while stickiness remains blocked at the focal sister pair by absence of a direct local manipulation/fitness study.
